jobs.title: International Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: Role Overview Sprout is looking for an International GTM Marketing Specialist to help take selected Sprout products into new markets across Southeast Asia and Asia-Pacific. This is not a traditional marketing role. You will operate as an AI-enabled GTM marketer, using Sprout's marketing technology, AI agents, product knowledge and internal specialists to research new markets, build campaigns, create content and landing pages, activate demand-generation channels, and learn what works. You may be a fresh graduate with exceptional AI fluency and a strong foundation in B2B marketing, or an early-career marketer with 2–3 years of experience in B2B software, technology or services. What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, think commercially, use AI exceptionally well, and turn ideas into measurable GTM execution.

jobs.title: Import Department Buyer
jobs.description: Position Overview : We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Supply Chain Associate / Import Buyer to join our growing team. The Supply Chain Associate handles communication with global suppliers and assists in the product development cycle. This role is essential in managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, particularly focused on international purchasing, vendor management, and ensuring timely and cost-effective importation of goods. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of global supply chains, procurement practices, and import regulations. Key responsibilities include : Vendor Management: Identify and establish relationships with international suppliers and negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts. Purchasing & Procurement: Manage the procurement of goods from international markets, ensuring the best quality, price, and delivery terms. Order Management: Place and track purchase orders, manage order confirmations, and resolve discrepancies with suppliers. Logistics Coordination: Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of imported goods. Import Documentation: Ensure all required documents (commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, etc.) are accurate and compliant with international and local regulations. Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels and work with internal teams to ensure optimal inventory levels are maintained. Customs Compliance: Ensure adherence to all customs laws, regulations, and import/export guidelines, including tariff classifications and duty calculations. Cost Control: Analyze and manage procurement costs to align with budgetary goals and maximize savings. Vendor Performance Evaluation: Track supplier performance, delivery times, and quality, and work with vendors to improve service. Serve as the sales liaison for accreditation renewals and applications, ensuring all documentation is properly prepared and submitted.
